SELECT cp.subcategory AS cur_subcat, p.subcategory AS was_subcat, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_ids, sum(f.quantity) AS units, count(DISTINCT p.sku) skus, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=107 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=5 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  AND (cp.subcategory='Cleaning Products' OR p.subcategory='Cleaning Products')
GROUP BY 1,2

WITH base AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, f.quantity, f.net_amount, p.category, p.subcategory, f.staff_purchase_flag
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE s.store_id=107 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=5)
SELECT 'all_units_excl_test' k, sum(quantity) v FROM base WHERE category<>'ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'all_units_incl_test', sum(quantity) FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'rpt_units', (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=107 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27')
UNION ALL SELECT 'cp_min_qty', min(quantity) FROM base WHERE subcategory='Cleaning Products'
UNION ALL SELECT 'cp_max_qty', max(quantity) FROM base WHERE subcategory='Cleaning Products'
UNION ALL SELECT 'cp_staff_units', sum(quantity) FROM base WHERE subcategory='Cleaning Products' AND staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL SELECT 'cp_nonpos_net', count(*) FROM base WHERE subcategory='Cleaning Products' AND (net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0)

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.*, cp.subcategory AS cur_sub, cp.category AS cur_cat, p.subcategory AS wasub
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 107 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 'cleaning_lines' k, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) nd, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) nd2, sum(quantity) units, sum(net_amount) net, min(etl_loaded_at)::VARCHAR a, max(etl_loaded_at)::VARCHAR b FROM base WHERE cur_sub='Cleaning Products'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'cleaning_asWas', count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)), sum(quantity), sum(net_amount), '', '' FROM base WHERE wasub='Cleaning Products'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'all_cats_vs_rpt', count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)), sum(quantity), sum(net_amount), CAST((SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=107 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS VARCHAR), CAST((SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=107 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS VARCHAR) FROM base
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_cleaning', count(*), count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id), 0, sum(r.quantity_returned), sum(r.refund_net), '', '' FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current WHERE s.store_id=107 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND cp.subcategory='Cleaning Products'
